Description
Gold cast bars are made in simple processes, so these bars are quite cheaper than minted bars of equal weight and can be bought and sold easily in the market. Cast bars are made by pouring onto molten gold, plan gold pieces in various sizes and weights.
Italpreziosi is a trustworthy European gold and silver refinery that has collected massive customers by producing high-quality products. The 5 oz Italpreziosi Italian Gold Cast Bar has a simple design containing 5 troy of .9999 fine gold. These gold bars have the potential to hold value for the long run, which is an opportunity for investors to buy Italian gold cast bars efficiently. You can now buy this product from Bullion Trading LLC in New York, USA.
Design of
5 oz Italpreziosi Italian Gold Cast Bar
The weight and purity of the bar are normally displayed on the front of the bar, which is 5 oz and.9999 pure gold, respectively. The bar shows the manufacturer’s emblem on the observing side of the gold bar. The refiner logo is an oval with the name on it, while in the middle of the product, you will find a marking of 5 oz fine gold 999.9. And, Italpreziosi and a unique serial number engraved on it. In comparison, the reverse side of this Italian gold bar is blank.
Highlights of 5 oz Italpreziosi Italian Gold Cast Bar
This Product Contains 5 Troy oz of .9999 pure gold.
Each Product has a unique serial number.
The observer side of 1 oz Valcambi has identifying hallmarks.
The Reverse side is a blank element.
You will get each Product in Plastic Bag.
